verification: All six processes reproduced pinned report semantics, regenerated JSON/ID bytes, and passed every verification scope.

nonadditive_scopes.detached_bundle_verification: In-memory bundle; finite raw semantics and source-code hashes. Excludes bundle file parsing and exact-ID sidecars.
nonadditive_scopes.directory_verification: Existing verify_directory with verify_sources=False: includes file reads, JSON/gzip decoding, file digests, detached semantic verification and exact-ID/sidecar consistency. Does not prove the ID set against the original mapping. This reads the fixed existing exported directory; regenerated report objects equal it, and the exact-ID gzip is byte-identical. Its JSON field ordering is the prior exporter ordering.
nonadditive_scopes.directory_with_original_source_reconcili: Existing verify_directory with verify_sources=True: contains all directory verification plus pinned derived-archive/source hashes, 50,931 native receipt/query mappings and exact affected-ID source reconciliation. Sources are derived public-data artifacts, not a fresh parse of the original XES.

measurement_boundaries.report_construction: Actual make_bundle API over 25 requests; raw summary computation, witnesses, bindings and source-code hashing included. Uses prepared inputs and retained provenance. Excludes all input/spec loading, saved-diagnostic comparison, directory review/manifest construction, file writing and subsequent verification; not monolithic export() runtime.
measurement_boundaries.exact_id_construction: Filters 50,931 stored receipt/class mappings using freshly recomputed strict statuses; constructs 33,489 rows. Does not compute 50,931 individual report payloads.
measurement_boundaries.payload_serialization: Matches existing indented bundle JSON and deterministic exact-ID gzip bytes in memory. Excludes review/manifest/verification JSON serialization and all filesystem writes.
measurement_boundaries.setup: Import load and JSON/spec reconstruction separately reported; parent subprocess wall time includes startup, all stages, post-timing correctness checks and result serialization.
measurement_boundaries.excluded: No fsync/durable writes, physical acquisition savings, remote network, access authentication, concurrent load control or human decision effects. File reads in verification may hit shared OS caches.
measurement_boundaries.interpretation: Medians and ranges of five same-host rounds are descriptive, not confidence intervals. Verification scopes overlap; their times cannot be summed. No comparison with previous-host benchmarks is paired or a speedup estimate.
measurement_boundaries.integrity: All verification APIs receive an independently fixed expected bundle digest from this protocol. Hashes and mock envelopes bind content; they do not authenticate issuers or prove live freshness.
